groups.defect: In Google CalendarService, the fallback in updateEvent (line 256) and deleteEvent (line 317) runs only when externalCalendarId is falsy. It then searches destinationCalendar with cal.externalId === externalCalendarId, which compares against that same falsy value, so it never matches and the fallback always returns undefined. Fix: fall back to destinationCalendar[0]?.externalId.

answer.reasoning:
All five suggestions report the same problem. In updateEvent and deleteEvent, the fallback only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy, but it then looks for a destination calendar whose externalId equals that same falsy value, so it never finds one. Four of them name both functions directly. s_c779c607 only describes the fix, but its line range (253-317) covers both functions and the fix is the same one the others give. So the five belong in one group.

The defect does appear in two places, both inside the same 65-line span of one file. Every member already describes both places and the same fix, so any single member could stand in for the group without losing anything. For that reason I labeled the group same_location with needsUnifiedComment=false rather than systemic_pattern. That choice is a judgment call, but which suggestions are duplicates is clear-cut.
